focus: Design an AIOps system that predicts future resource demands using ML models and proactively scales infrastructure, reducing both over-provisioning costs and under-provisioning incidents.
action: Forecast resource demand using historical patterns
latency: Forecast accuracy within 15% of actual demand
durable: Forecast resource demand using historical patterns; Scale infrastructure proactively before demand spikes
async: Use time-series forecasting (Prophet, DeepAR) for demand prediction, Implement multi-step forecasting for different horizons, Use calendar features for event-driven scaling
